title: Abide, O Dearest Jesus
description: Abide, O Dearest Jesus in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 6 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Joshua Stegmann, first published in 1628. The English translation is by August Crull (1892). The tune, CHRISTUS DER IST MEIN LEBEN, is by Melchior Vulpius (1609). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.
underlay: A-bide, O dear-est Je-sus, A-mong us with Thy grace, That Sa-tan may not harm us, Nor we to sin give place.

lines: That Satan may not harm us,
Nor we to sin give place.
Thy truth direct, and keep us
Let us in grace and wisdom
Lest world and Satan fell us
Abide, O faithful Savior, Among us with Thy love;
Grant steadfastness, and help us To reach our home above.
